hints.title: Notes
data: The celebration will partly take place in the garden if the weather is good.
You can expect a buffet where you can serve yourself flexibly and according to your own preferences.

Share your best moments with us: from the wedding day onward, you can upload your photos easily via QR code and password (from the invitation) on our website. After activation, you can also view everyone else's pictures.
